cases.name: production drawing rejects missing and standalone diagnostic QC methods before output or child processes
diagnostic completed-frame QC also requires an explicitly selected method before any work
public combined QC entry rejects an unsupported frame rate before every media child without fallback
public combined QC entry rejects absent, relative or changed normal-plan references before every media child
production evaluator accepts complete combined evidence with valid application, layout and media inputs
production final QC rejects old pixel-count and valid native-only evidence without the new global proof
production evaluator rejects missing global evidence or a missing whole-video proof
production evaluator rejects a missing or substituted current completed-video path or hash
production evaluator rejects whole-video corruption even when native state observations pass
production evaluator rejects an omitted native caption even when whole-video equality passes
production evaluator rejects detached finite-state evidence and a mixed comparison basis
production Pulse rejects legacy final proof and retains native state checks without duplicate new-method requirements
combined proof accepts matching complete evidence and ignores cached decisions without mutating inputs
combined proof rejects missing whole-video evidence despite cached pass flags
combined proof rejects mixing individually valid observations from different completed videos
combined proof requires the current completed-video path and hash supplied by its caller
combined proof rejects local/global disagreement and a severed RGB stdout or artifact chain
combined proof rejects altered batch clocks, prepared alpha, missing processes and false reference sharing
combined proof rejects missing or substituted planar layers and a severed decode-to-composition chain
all decoded frame hashes retain order and exact rational timestamps
frame parser rejects malformed hash, incomplete pixel data, wrong canvas and decimal timestamps
audio parser retains payload order and integer-clock metadata, including negative initial AAC PTS
audio parser rejects missing packet hashes, uncovered streams and inexact numeric clocks
byte equality and full decoded equality are independently valid exact gates
one changed frame, all-black corruption, changed audio, order and timing are rejected with recomputed digests
a cached pass cannot replace complete observations, stable input bindings or original encoder arguments
byte equality does not invent decoded-frame counts, and an MP4 hash mismatch cannot skip full comparison
mock I/O runs one replay from the real compositor arguments and reports no unobserved decoded frames
mock I/O compares every decoded frame and audio packet when container bytes differ
mock I/O preserves exact failure for an unknown one-pixel change
mock I/O detects inputs changing during encode and rejects a missing production PNG before any child
pulse replay binds every production PNG to its exact native state and order
bounce replay binds every production PNG to its exact native state and order
shake replay binds every production PNG to its exact native state and order
current completed-file identity is mandatory and rejects a stale pass for another same-format video
raw evidence, all observed commands, original stdout and artifact correspondence are mandatory
parsed equality cannot conceal different raw framehash or packet output with freshly recomputed proof hashes
sample/display aspect, color meaning and display side data must match despite identical pixel hashes
bounce native QC rejects clamping, unbound images, missing states and invalid static layouts
bounce collision checks follow the moving state interval beyond the disjoint stable box
shake native QC rejects clamping, unbound images, missing states and invalid static layouts
shake collision checks follow the moving state interval beyond the disjoint stable box
the fixed recipe includes every caption and all moving Pulse frames without caller-selected samples
mandatory Color/Panel/Normal references and their drawing conditions cannot be silently omitted
a partial selection that covers the whole caption still gets the resolver-required duplicate alternative
foreign references occupy the target clock and candidate bounds, not the inactive caption clock or corrupted frame bounds
simultaneous captions retain their own fades and receive a real pair-order alternative
exact pixel classes permit a Normal alias but reject target absence and an unequal-image tie
whole-caption overpaint and foreign pixels need adversarial references even without empirical thresholds
the pure validator accepts complete synthetic evidence and independently rejects material evidence tampering
bounce native recipe covers every entrance frame and stable visibility with every wrong state as an adversary
bounce rejects a missing, reordered or mixed native state set and missing entrance/stable observations
shake native recipe covers every entrance frame and stable visibility with every wrong state as an adversary
shake rejects a missing, reordered or mixed native state set and missing entrance/stable observations
shared and separately read common evidence retain every standalone native decision
a valid preceding caption cannot hide changed common evidence or local observations
native unique-minimum failure remains failed with the same violation after common reuse
a later call revalidates mutated common inputs without trusting the earlier result
combined snapshot detaches inputs while preserving common and sample sharing across local/global evidence
renderer QC snapshot preserves shared evidence across captions and whole-video proof without aliasing its input
valid JSON envelope preserves every observation while common objects are restored once
a separate Node process preserves shared identity and the existing RGB classifier result
large expanded common data never becomes a multi-gigabyte string, including in a fresh reader
common content, common SHA and inspection-specific tampering are rejected
missing common, missing inspection, invalid references and unknown schema are rejected
file binding detects re-serialized transport bytes and refuses existing-file overwrite
literal reference-like keys, prototype-like keys and existing JSON undefined semantics are retained
cycles and non-JSON values fail without silently changing the evidence
the production post-render rejection preserves failed observations on disk and emits a small CLI report
exception evidence is preserved separately and neither duplicate-save nor missing-directory errors restore the huge inline graph
a missing saved evidence file is rejected by the reader

runs.scope: 現行編集jobの保存・登録・再起動・retry

cases.name: 即時失敗を記録し、後から保存が進んでも失敗時の状態を再試行する
媒体登録後の中断から再起動して成功記録を補完し登録時刻を変えない
partial-fail: 部分媒体と未完了結果を残しても失敗・取消後と再起動後に公開しない
partial-cancel: 部分媒体と未完了結果を残しても失敗・取消後と再起動後に公開しない
実行中の保存は固定入力を変えず、同時開始と復帰後の二重完了を防ぐ
未変更の検証済み時計は再利用し、同一size/mtimeの改変もctimeから検出する
生成結果と描画証拠も検証cacheで改変を見逃さない
service終了ではworkerだけでなく同じgroupの子processにも停止を伝える
